name: The Black Sea Captain
description: A cigar-holding former ship captain in a warm-cream naval uniform who treats every coalition like rough water.

comebacks.weak: Summer called. It refuses responsibility for your winter excuses.
comebacks.medium: Your argument has more holes than my campaign promises.
comebacks.strong: That was barely a debate. Your flagship surrendered to a fishing float.
